test.run:
# The adapter's tests (adapter/; the blog in the root has none). Test reports (JUnit) for the check runner's per-file times (ADR 0028).
reports="${CHECK_REPORT_DIR:-$RUNNER_TEMP/reports}"
mkdir -p "$reports"
# The newest Node 24 release from nodejs.org.
node_ver=$(curl -fsSL --retry 3 https://nodejs.org/dist/index.json | python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(next(r["version"] for r in json.load(sys.stdin) if r["version"].startswith("v24.")))')
mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/node24"
curl -fsSL --retry 3 "https://nodejs.org/dist/$node_ver/node-$node_ver-linux-x64.tar.xz" | tar -xJ -C "$RUNNER_TEMP/node24" --strip-components=1
export PATH="$RUNNER_TEMP/node24/bin:$PATH"
node --version
cd adapter
# npm ci with a deadline per attempt and up to 3 attempts (tyu41275/Clock#57).
bash scripts/ci-npm-ci.sh
npm run typecheck
# Fast tests only: files with `slow` in the name run in the scheduled slow-tests check (ADR 0028).
npm test -- --reporter=default --reporter=junit --outputFile.junit="$reports/vitest.xml"
npm run lint:file-sizes
test.retry:
# The adapter's tests (adapter/; the blog in the root has none). Test reports (JUnit) for the check runner's per-file times (ADR 0028).
reports="${CHECK_REPORT_DIR:-$RUNNER_TEMP/reports}"
mkdir -p "$reports"
# The newest Node 24 release from nodejs.org.
node_ver=$(curl -fsSL --retry 3 https://nodejs.org/dist/index.json | python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(next(r["version"] for r in json.load(sys.stdin) if r["version"].startswith("v24.")))')
mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/node24"
curl -fsSL --retry 3 "https://nodejs.org/dist/$node_ver/node-$node_ver-linux-x64.tar.xz" | tar -xJ -C "$RUNNER_TEMP/node24" --strip-components=1
export PATH="$RUNNER_TEMP/node24/bin:$PATH"
node --version
cd adapter
# npm ci with a deadline per attempt and up to 3 attempts (tyu41275/Clock#57).
bash scripts/ci-npm-ci.sh
# The failed test files again ($CHECK_RETRY_FILES), then what `run` does after its tests.
npx vitest run --reporter=default --reporter=junit --outputFile.junit="$reports/vitest.xml" $CHECK_RETRY_FILES
npm run lint:file-sizes
